\textbf{Problem (Own).} Let $P$ be a point lies on the Darboux cubic of $\triangle ABC$ with its pedal triangle $DEF$ and $Q$ be the perspector of $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle DEF$. Let $T$ be the orthogonal projection of $Q$ on $BC$. Prove that the radical axis of $(BTE)$ and $(CTF)$ is parallel to $AD$.
